seoTitle: Lean Canvas Builder: One-Page Business Plan
metaDescription: Fill in the nine boxes of a lean canvas and get a printable one-page canvas. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Lays the nine lean canvas boxes out on one page you can save or print.
why:
The lean canvas fits a business idea on one page: problem, solution, value proposition, unfair advantage, customer segments, key metrics, channels, costs and revenue. It forces short answers and shows the gaps.

Write a point per line in each box. The result is an HTML page you can save or print to PDF. Nothing is uploaded.
howTo: Fill each box with short points, one per line.
Save the page or print it to PDF.

faq.a: With the problem and customer segments, then the value proposition.
